The accused/applicant has preferred this second bail application under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure for releasing him on regular bail in connection with Crime No. 36/2022 registered at Police Station: Vaishali Nagar, District Durg (C.G.) for commission of offence punishable under Sections 376,354 (A)(1) & 342 of the Indian Penal Code and Sections 4, 9(f) & 10 (twice) of Prevention of Children from Sexual Offence Act, 2012.

sentences.text: Neutral Citation 2023:CGHC:21353 3.

Case of the prosecution, in brief, is that on 14.02.2022, applicant, who is Tuition Teacher, called his student, who is minor victim/prosecutrix, by sending her message in the morning at 9 am and when victim reached to his home, then applicant took her insider the room and hugged her, kissed her lip, pressed her breast and forcefully tried to put off her under garments.
During investigation, it was also revealed that applicant has molested her other student also.

On the basis of aforesaid facts,
FIR was registered against the applicant for the aforesaid offences.
The applicant was arrested on 15.02.2022.
After usual investigation, charge-sheet has been filed against the applicant for the aforesaid offences.

4. Learned counsel appearing for the applicant would submit that the applicant is old aged person of about 57 years and he is a Tuition Teacher; he has been falsely implicated in the crime in question,
as he has not committed the aforesaid offences.
It is further submitted that the charge- sheet has already been filed and almost the trial is at the verge of its conclusion.

It is further submitted that vide order dated 26.04.2023, the applicant has been granted ad-interim bail, till disposal of main bail application and, therefore, in these circumstances, he may be enlarged on bail.

5. Per contra, learned counsel for the State would submit that earlier charge-sheet was filed against applicant for the offence under Sections 354 (A) (1) & 342 of the Indian Penal Code and Sections 9 (f) & 10 (twice) of the POCSO Act.
Subsequently, after filing of charge-sheet, learned trial Court has framed charge under Section 376 of IPC & Section 4 of the POCSO Act alongwith aforesaid charges.
It is further submitted that being a Teacher, conduct of the applicant is tantamount to very gruesome, hence, applicant is not entitled to be released on bail.
Neutral Citation 2023:CGHC:21353 6.
Earlier counsel was appearing on behalf of victim/prosecurix, but today none present on her behalf.
7. I have heard learned counsel appearing for the parties and perused the case diary.

8. Having heard learned counsel for the parties, having regard to the facts & circumstances of the case, particularly, considering the fact that as has been stated that the trial is on the verge of its conclusion and the applicant has already been granted interim bail by this Court, till disposal of the main bail application by this Court vide order dated 26.04.2023, hence, considering the totality of the case, I am inclined to release the applicant on regular bail.
Hence, the second bail application filed by the applicant is allowed.
9. Accused/applicant is directed to be released on bail on his executing a personal bond in the sum of Rs. 50,000/- with one surety in the like sum to the satisfaction of the trial Court.
He is directed to appear before the trial Court on each and every date given by the said Court till disposal of the trial.
